one_line: Sultan of Bengal who held Ekdala against Firuz Shah Tughluq and secured practical autonomy for his marshland kingdom.

appearance.face: oval face with sharp jawline, medium-brown Bengal complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, focused almond-shaped eyes, default expression calm and strategic with a slight confident half-smile
appearance.hair: straight black hair to just below the ears, oiled and combed back from the forehead, mostly hidden under a deep green, slightly conical Bengal-style turban wrapped low with a thin gold braid and a small red cloth tail at the back
appearance.costume: long off-white cotton jama (front-wrapped tunic) reaching mid-shin with side slits, worn over loose straight-cut deep green trousers; a rich maroon silk patka (sash) with subtle gold floral brocade tied at the waist and hanging to the knee; a lightweight dark teal quilted cotton coat (near knee length, open at front) with simple straight sleeves and minimal stitching; soft brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; modest gold hoop earrings, a slim gold signet ring on the right hand, and a short gold chain with a small circular pendant at the neck.
appearance.signature: a slightly curved single-edged Indo-Turkic sword with a simple steel blade, modest brass crossguard, and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried sheathed at his left hip in a plain dark brown scabbard with minimal brass fittings.

ref_desc: Sikandar Shah of Bengal is a lean early-30s man with a medium-brown oval face, short black beard, deep green turban, off-white jama, deep green trousers, maroon brocaded sash, dark teal quilted coat, brown upturned shoes, and a curved sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sikandar Shah of Bengal: a lean early-30s man with a medium-brown oval face, sharp jaw, straight nose, focused almond eyes, and a neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, his straight black hair combed back under a deep green, slightly conical Bengal-style turban wrapped with a thin gold braid and a small red cloth tail at the back. Dress him in an off-white cotton jama reaching mid-shin with side slits, over loose deep green straight-cut trousers, tied with a rich maroon silk patka sash that has subtle gold floral brocade and hangs to his knee. Add a lightweight dark teal quilted cotton coat, knee length and open at the front, with simple straight sleeves and visible quilting texture, plus soft brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. Include modest gold hoop earrings, a slim gold ring on his right hand, and a short gold chain with a small circular pendant at his neck. At his left hip, show his signature slightly curved single-edged sword sheathed in a plain dark brown scabbard with minimal brass fittings. Use deep green, maroon, off-white, dark teal, and brown as the dominant colours, and present him front-facing in a dignified, strategic stance suitable for many panels.
